Thermo Fisher.notes: KingFisher is a high-throughput paramagnetic-bead instrument platform. PDQeX is portable and suited to low-throughput point-of-need settings.
Thermo Fisher.advantages: PDQeX is substantially lower cost. No bead-based consumables. No software or instrument service dependency. Portable and field-deployable.

NEB.competitorProduct: Monarch Genomic DNA Purification Kit; Monarch Spin gDNA Extraction Kit
NEB.notes: Both extract gDNA from blood and tissue. Monarch uses silica spin-column technology with chaotropic buffers. NEB Monarch is a well-regarded, eco-conscious product.
NEB.advantages: No chaotropic buffers or spin columns. Single closed-tube enzymatic process. Lower inhibitor risk. Fewer consumables. Primary Exymes advantages are inhibitor-free chemistry and protocol simplicity.

NEB.competitorProduct: Monarch HMW DNA Extraction Kit; Monarch Mag HMW DNA Kit
NEB.notes: HMW DNA for long-read sequencing is outside the current Exymes portfolio.

NEB.competitorProduct: Monarch Mag Cell-Free DNA Extraction Kit
NEB.notes: cfDNA extraction is outside the current Exymes portfolio.
Plasmid purification is not within the Exymes portfolio.

NEB.competitorProduct: Monarch PCR & DNA Cleanup Kit; Monarch DNA Gel Extraction Kit
NEB.notes: Post-extraction PCR cleanup is not required when using Exymes products as no inhibitors are introduced. NEB Monarch PCR cleanup for downstream sequencing prep is a separate downstream requirement.
NEB.advantages: Exymes eliminates the need for inhibitor-removal cleanup post-extraction. NEB Monarch PCR cleanup addresses a separate downstream need.

NEB.subcategory: Total RNA from cells and tissues
NEB.notes: Both extract total RNA from cells and tissue. Monarch Total RNA uses silica-column format with optional DNase I treatment. RNAGEM is phenol-free and column-free.
NEB.advantages: RNAGEM is phenol-free and column-free. Faster single-tube process. No DNase treatment step required for most RT-PCR applications. Particularly well-suited to small or precious inputs.

NEB.notes: RNAGEM eluate is ready for RT-PCR without post-extraction cleanup. A separate RNA cleanup step is not required as part of the Exymes extraction workflow.
NEB.advantages: RNAGEM eluate is directly usable for RT-PCR, eliminating a workflow step compared to methods that require post-extraction cleanup or concentration.

NEB.competitorProduct: Monarch Total RNA Miniprep (small RNA protocol)
NEB.notes: Both capture total RNA including miRNA. RNAGEM does not restrict by size. NEB Monarch requires a spin-column wash protocol.
NEB.advantages: RNAGEM is faster and phenol-free. Both capture miRNA as part of total RNA.

NEB.competitorProduct: NEB does not offer a dedicated extraction instrument
NEB.notes: NEB's Monarch range is entirely manual and spin-column based. NEB does not offer an automated extraction instrument platform.
NEB.advantages: Exymes offers PDQeX as a portable automated extraction option. NEB has no comparable instrument for customers requiring automation.
